mapper.sql: SELECT o.*, p.name AS pet_name, p.species, p.breed, c.name AS owner_name, c.phone AS owner_phone, r.code AS room_code, r.room_type, b.bill_no AS bill_no FROM boarding_order o JOIN pet p ON p.id = o.pet_id JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN boarding_room r ON r.id = o.room_id LEFT JOIN bill b ON b.id = o.bill_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM boarding_order WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND status = 'CHECKED_IN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boarding_order(order_no, customer_id, pet_id, room_id, start_at, planned_end_on, unit_price_cent, deposit_cent, status, remark, created_at, created_by) VALUES(#{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{petId}, #{roomId}, #{startAt}, #{plannedEndOn}, #{unitPriceCent}, #{depositCent}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE boarding_order SET status = 'CHECKED_IN', start_at = #{startAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'BOOKED'
UPDATE boarding_order SET planned_end_on = #{plannedEndOn}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('BOOKED', 'CHECKED_IN')
UPDATE boarding_order SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'BOOKED'
mapper.select: WHERE o.status = 'CHECKED_IN' ORDER BY o.planned_end_on ASC
WHERE o.status = 'BOOKED' AND substr(o.start_at, 1, 10) = #{today} ORDER BY o.start_at ASC
WHERE o.status = 'CHECKED_IN' AND o.planned_end_on <= #{today} ORDER BY o.planned_end_on ASC

where.if: AND (o.order_no LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.phone LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.select: ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM boarding_order o JOIN pet p ON p.id = o.pet_id JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM boarding_order WHERE order_no LIKE #{prefix} || '%'
